Sir:
I submit to you here my opposition to the proposed Airport Spur Highway Project and request that the following comments be received, considered, and inserted in the Final Environmental Impact Statement. My comments will be limited to two topics.
I. Specific comments directed at statements that seem to be errors or oversights.
II. Comments on what I perceive to be the stated goals of the nation, the state, and the department towards transportation. The contradiction of this project with these goals. Consideration of alternatives.
I. OVFRSIGHTS AND/OR ERRORS
On page 25 you state that SEMRPC has completed and adopted a comprehensive regional land-use plan which recommends that General Mitchell Field be connected to I-94 by a four lane divided freeway facility. I must point out that on the Proposed Land Use And Freeway System 1990, Figure 5, no such route is marked out and included in the map. Is there any explanation?
On page 83 you state, "However, the magnitude of this impact becomes a <u>function</u> of the relocation assistance provided to affected persons." (emphasis added). This comment addresses itself to the appropriateness of such phrasing in a document intended for review by citizens of all educational backgrounds. I find it confusing, potentially embarrassing and totally unnecessary. Such a thought should be
